newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX Hub natgas mixed late, fronts hold gains.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX Hub natgas mixed late, fronts hold gains.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natural gas futures remained mixed late Wednesday in active trade, with front months still holding pared gains on reports of strength in physical prices, industry sources said.
At 1350 EDT, May was up by 4.1 cents at $2.155 per million British thermal units after rallying early to $2.20. June was 0.1 cent higher at $2.165. Most others were steady to down.

"It's (the recent rally) been a classic short squeeze in cash and futures. People were covering, then trying to reshort and getting killed, but I don't think the fundamentals in May support this move," said one East Coast trader.

Most agreed buy stops were triggered Tuesday when May broke above $2.10, then again this morning when the spot contract, set to expire Thursday, breached $2.16. Chart traders said there was good selling in May ahead of $2.21 resistance. May support was seen at $2.09, $2.035 and $1.925.

Technically, this morning June closed the $2.21-2.23 gap from mid-January and looked set to test next resistance in the $2.33 area, but many said the market was overbought and due for a pullback. June support was pegged at $2.085 and then along the short-term up trendline in the $2.00 area.

A Reuter poll of industry players showed most expected U.S. gas stocks unchanged to 10 bcf higher when weekly American Gas Association storage data are released later today. For the same week last year, inventories gained 27 bcf.

In the cash, Gulf Coast prices jumped 10 cents or more to the $2.15-20 area, with gas at Henry Hub mostly quoted in the low-$2.20s. Midcontinent pipes also gained more than a dime to the $2.05 area. Gas at the New York city gate rallied by about 15 cents to the $2.50s.
NYMEX said 54,760 Hub contracts traded at 1315 EDT.
On the KCBT, May climbed one cent to $2.03, while deferreds mostly remained up by one-half to three cents. The East/West spread widened by 3.1 cents to 12.5 cents (NYMEX premium).
KCBT May natgas expires Friday, April 25.
